name: SMIC Lingang 12-inch Fab, Shanghai

parties.name: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation
parties.note: 70.35% of a USD 3,733 million registered capital at the end of 2022; 69.97% of USD 5,500 million in the 2025 annual results.

parties.note: Injected capital into SMOC, together with the Shenzhen and Beijing joint ventures, during 2022.

summary: A 300 mm foundry fab built by SMIC's majority-owned Lingang subsidiary in Shanghai. SMIC planned it in 2021 at about USD 8.87 billion for 100,000 wafers a month at 28nm and above; trade press later described that line as the first phase of a CNY 100 billion project. Construction began in January 2022 and the Phase 1 shell was topped out that December; production started in 2023, and in November 2026 Phase 1 was described as ramping while the first section of Phase 2 passed its pre-construction check in October 2026.

location.site: Lingang Special Area, China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone

metrics.note: SMIC's 2021 plan for the 100,000-wafer line, with USD 5.5 billion of registered capital; trade press citing Xinhua Finance described it as the first phase.
Whole-project total that trade press attributed to Xinhua Finance, of which CNY 57.6 billion for the first phase.
Planned 300 mm wafers per month, built in three stages of 20,000, 30,000 and 50,000.

milestones.note: SMIC disclosed the cooperation agreement with the Lingang administration in an exchange filing in early September 2021.
Formal start of construction; SMIC described the Shanghai 12-inch fab as under construction in August 2022.
Phase 1 structure topped out; SMIC said the main fab shell was complete by the end of 2022.
Trade press gave 2023 as the production year; the month is not reported. Phase 1 was described as ramping in November 2026.
Reported target for reaching full output by the end of 2027.

notes: SMIC's September 2021 filing itself was not opened for this record; its figures come from news and trade-press reports. The 2025 annual results list SMOC among the subsidiaries on the mandatory environmental disclosure list. Phase 2 is recorded only through the October 2026 pre-construction check; no budget, capacity or start date for it has been cited.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Re-scoped the USD 8.87 billion and 100,000-wafer figures to Phase 1 and added the CNY 100 billion project total, dated construction start and topping out from the cited trade report, added a 2021 news source for the announcement and the Lingang Special Area site.
